title: Wet Glaze? Painting Disaster!
content: Things don’t go as planned as I paint a cake display at the diner. First the primer (acrylic latex house paint) makes the gouache bead up. Then I try covering the background with a blue-colored glaze, and everything melts. It’s a race to rescue the painting before the omelette arrives.--New YouTube video:"Wet Glaze Over Gouache?
